description: Files the number on a beneficial owner's passport or US driver's license against a banking application, for an owner who has no SSN or ITIN. Record the document first (kind, issuing country, expiry, and the issuing state for a license) on the owner. The number goes to the secret store; only its last four are recorded, which is all the response returns. Pass it once and do not repeat it back.
name: banking_set_owner_identity_document_number
title: Set Owner Identity Document Number
